text:
TAQAT AL-YAWM AL-'AAMMAH
Tathawwaru al-yawm taaqatun falakiyyatun dafi'atun wa-mushriqatun tumalliu qalbaka bi-al-sakinah wa-al-amal ya burj al-sartan. Yatlubu minka al-yawm an tata'ammala fi al-madi bi-masha'ir al-ridha wa-an tantazira al-mustaqbal bi-shaghafin kabir, fa-al-falak yushir ila fursa hقيقيyah li-ta'zis al-istiqrar al-nafsi al-ladhi tabthatu 'anhu dawman. Ruhuk al-atufah satukunu masdaran li-al-quwwah al-yawm, wa-satajidu nafsaka tumalliu ghurfataka bi-taqah ijabiyyah ta'muru man hawlaka bi-al-raha wa-al-itminan.

AL-'ISHQ WA-AL-ILAQAT
Lil-murتبطin minhum, al-yawm huwa al-waqt al-mithali li-ta'ziz al-rawabit al-'atifah ma'a al-sharik 'abra hiwar sadiq wa-laheeth dafi' yuzilu ayy shuwab sabiq. Amma lil-'uzzab, fa-al-nujum tunbi'u bi-liqaa' ghayr mutawaqqa' qad yuqallibu kayana al-qalb wa-yuqidhu fika mashair al-hubb min jadid duna sabiq inthar. Kula al-halatayn tuthbitu anna qalbaka al-kabir musta'iddun li-istaqbal al-dafi' wa-al-hanan al-ladhi yastahiqquhu jadiran.

AL-'AMM WA-AL-MATAR
Tuwajiha al-yawm furasan zahiratan fi majal 'amalik, fa-al-tarkiz wa-al-ibda' alladhani tamliku huma miftaah al-najah al-yawm. Qad tataqallaq ma'a zamil jadid aw tata'awwan ma'a mashru' yahtaju ila lamsatika al-insaniyyah al-muhibbah, fa-la taraddad fi taqdim ra'yika bi-thiqah al-wathiq. Ittaqi faqat al-tashatut al-dhihni wa-kulli ma min sha'nihi an yusriqa taqataka al-thaminah fi tafasil ghayr muhimmah.

AL-MAL WA-AL-BARAKAH
Al-wad' al-mali yatamatta'u bi-istiqrar malhooz al-yawm, ma yuminu laka sha'uran bi-al-raha wa-al-itminan al-mali. Qad tatلقa khabaran sarran yakhussu ziyadatan fi al-dakhl aw furwatan istithariyyah jadidah tastaqhibluha bi-akthar al-tahmid. Rağma dhalika, unshud al-tawazin bayn al-ifrat fi al-shira' wa-al-taqtir, wa-aj'al yadavka mamduwatan lil-khair wa-al-sadaqat fa-al-barakah tazidu bi-al-'ata'.

AL-SIHHAH WA-AL-TAQAH
Sihhatuka al-nafsiyyah wa-al-jasadiyyah fi ahsan halatiha idha akhadhta waqtan kafiha lil-istiraha wa-al-istijmam ba'idha 'an daghat al-hayaq al-yawmiyyah. Unshud al-qurb min al-ma' aw al-amakin al-tabi'iyyah al-hadi'ah li-i'adad shahin taqatika al-dakhiliyyah wa-tanqiyat ruhiha. Tanawwal al-wajibhat al-sihhiyyah al-dafi'ah wa-akthir min shurb al-ma' li-tahqiq al-tawazin al-matlub fi jasadika.

AL-TAWASUL WA-AL-MUHITH
'Alaqatuka ma'a al-a'ilah wa-al-asdiqa' ta'ishu fawran min al-tafahum al-'amiq wa-al-dafi' al-mushytarak. Qad tad'u ahad al-muqarribin li-jalsah hamiimah tumalliuha al-dhikrayat al-jamillah wa-al-dahik al-sadiq. Mawqifuka al-da'im lil-akharin sayaj'aluka al-malja' al-awwal li-kull man yabhat 'an al-nasiha aw al-da'm al-nafsi al-yawm.

NASIHAT AL-YAWM
Unsur ila al-hayaq bi-'ayn al-ridha, wa-la tansha' anna al-quwwah al-haqiqiyyah tanba'u min dakhil qalbika al-nariyyah al-hanunah; kun nafsaka wa-da' al-ayyam tushtiru laka ajmal al-awaqt.

TAFASIL AL-YAWM
Al-raqm al-haziz: 2
Al-lawn al-haziz: Al-Fiddiyy al-Lamhi
Al-burj al-mutawafiq: Burj al-Aqrab
